title: Code development
label: FACT
summary: The Australian Government asked the ACCC to develop a mandatory code addressing bargaining power imbalances between Australian news media businesses and digital platforms.

title: Mandatory Bargaining Code enacted
label: FACT
summary: The News Media and Digital Platforms Mandatory Bargaining Code was passed by both Houses on 25 February 2021 and came into effect on 2 March 2021.
detail: The framework addressed bargaining power imbalances between Australian news businesses and major digital platforms.

title: Voluntary commercial agreements
label: FACT
summary: No digital platforms were formally designated under the Code. The existence of the framework contributed to Google and Meta entering voluntary commercial agreements with Australian news organisations.

title: Pressure on the 2021 settlement
label: CONTEXT
summary: Commercial arrangements struck in the shadow of the Code faced sustainability questions as platform strategies and newsroom economics continued to shift.
detail: Exact commercial terms of platform–publisher agreements were generally not public.

title: News Bargaining Incentive / NMI
label: POLICY
summary: Parliament enacted the News Media Bargaining Charge Act 2026 and Administration Act, creating a charge–offset framework keyed to relevant Australian digital advertising revenue.
